title: Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 / KSeF XML Auditor
description: In-browser XML validator for Peppol BIS 3.0 (EN 16931-1:2017+A1:2019) and KSeF FA(3). Validates against embedded Schematron-equivalent business rules with country overlays for France PPF/PDP, Poland KSeF, Belgium PEPPOL-BE, Germany XRechnung, and AU PINT A-NZ. Client-side. Zero PII.

xml_content.description: Raw XML content of the e-invoice to validate (UBL 2.1 Invoice/CreditNote or CII CrossIndustryInvoice)

country_overlay.description: Country-specific validation overlay: none (core only), fr (France PPF/PDP), pl (Poland KSeF FA3), be (Belgium PEPPOL-BE), de (Germany XRechnung 3.0), au (AU PINT A-NZ)

overall_status.description: PASS = all rules satisfied; WARN = warnings only; FAIL = one or more errors

rule_results.description: Individual rule check results, sorted errors-first

rule_id.description: Rule identifier, e.g. BR-01, PEPPOL-R004, FR-PPF-01

element.description: XPath or element hint, e.g. cbc:CustomizationID

schema_version.description: Version string of the embedded rule set

country_overlay.description: Overlay applied to this validation run

parse_error.description: True if the XML could not be parsed

error_message.description: Parse error detail, if parse_error is true

mcp_tool_definition.name: validate_peppol_xml
mcp_tool_definition.description: Validates an e-invoice XML document against Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 (EN 16931-1:2017) business rules and optional country-specific overlays. Returns a structured list of rule results with severity, element path, pass/fail status, and regulatory citation. Use when an agent needs to verify invoice compliance before submission to PPF, KSeF, Peppol network, or any CTC platform.

xml_content.description: Raw XML content of the invoice (UBL 2.1 or CII)

country_overlay.description: Country overlay: none | fr (France PPF) | pl (Poland KSeF) | be (Belgium) | de (Germany XRechnung) | au (AU PINT)
